license_note: The qwen3.5-flash-2026-02-23 snapshot is served as a Model Studio API model under the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Service Agreement, effective September 2, 2026, which Model Studio's related-agreements page lists as governing the service. It is a paid-service contract that bars reselling the service or its models and using them or their outputs to train or develop competing products without written permission, and prohibits reverse engineering or trying to discover the service's source code. It grants no licence to model weights for redistribution or self-operation.

license_evidence.scope: Business and developer access to the qwen3.5-flash-2026-02-23 snapshot through Alibaba Cloud Model Studio API services

access_boundary: This record represents the Qwen3.5-Flash line at its only dated snapshot, qwen3.5-flash-2026-02-23, which Alibaba Cloud Model Studio serves with text, image, and video input and 1M context and to which the undated qwen3.5-flash model resolves. The Qwen3.5-35B-A3B open weights that Alibaba calls Qwen3.5-Flash's open counterpart, the Qwen3.5-Plus line, later Qwen generations, and independent hosts are separate boundaries.
strengths: Alibaba documents the dated snapshot with its own capability, context-limit, and pricing tables, states that the undated qwen3.5-flash model is functionally equivalent to it, and names the open weights it corresponds to
Text, image, and video input with 1M context, function calling, structured output, and web search, with Model Studio fine-tuning documented for the Chinese mainland deployment
tradeoffs: No downloadable weights exist under the Qwen3.5-Flash name; the corresponding Qwen3.5-35B-A3B open weights are a separate release that Alibaba says lacks hosted production features such as the 1M default context and built-in tools
Model Studio gives dated snapshots 30 days' retirement notice, against three months for mainline models
